title: A work order note says its lines were built from an inspection
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it: open a work order (Work Orders > New, pick a customer and unit), start an inspection from a template with a checkbox field, mark one field Not OK and one Monitor, then complete and sign it.
  3. Complete a build (S2): one build onto the run-on work order and one onto a new work order. Open the work order's Notes tab.
custom_steps:
1. On the work order the lines landed on, confirm a note was added stating it was built from the inspection.
2. When the lines went onto a new work order, confirm the note links back to the work order the inspection was run on.
3. When the lines went onto the run-on work order, confirm the note does not link to that work order from itself.
4. Confirm the Notes tab count includes the new note immediately.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A note is added to the work order the lines landed on, stating that it was built from the inspection.
  • When the lines went onto a new work order, the note links back to the work order the inspection was run on.
  • The Notes tab count includes the new note immediately.
  • If the lines went onto the run-on work order, the note does not link to that work order from itself.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9105 (S7 — Record where the lines came from); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S7; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R1: “A note will be added to the work order the lines landed on, stating that it was built from the inspection”
  • S7-R2: “When the lines went onto a new work order, the note will link back to the work order the inspection was run on”
  • S7-R3: “The Notes tab count will include the new note immediately”
  • S7-N1: “If the lines went onto the work order the inspection was run on, the note will not link to that work order from itself”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
